abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Max Energy Source
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crush and Burn
attacks.effect: You may discard as many Energy cards as you like attached to your Pokémon in play. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy card you discarded.

abilities.name: Red Signal
abilities.effect: When you attach a Plasma Energy from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Megalo Cannon
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Misty
cards.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has missy in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Grind
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Tyranitar.

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bite Off
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 70 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Beat Up
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play (including this one). This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Full Blitz
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Tag Bolt {GX}
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

abilities.name: Giant Water Shuriken
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack)	   , if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your oppponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.effect: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Amazing Shot
attacks.effect: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact
attacks.effect: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Absorption {GX}
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Group Therapy
attacks.effect: You and your opponent remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon with damage counters on them.

attacks.name: Pulled Punch
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Celestial Roar
attacks.effect: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Burst
attacks.effect: Discard all basic Fire Energy or all basic Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

abilities.name: Ultra Road
abilities.effect: Once during your turn		(before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sunsteel Strike
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sol Burst {GX}
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Hurl into Darkness
attacks.effect: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a number of Pokémon you find there up to the number of Psychic Energy attached to Gengar. Put the Pokémon you chose in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.effect: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Lost Crisis
attacks.effect: Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them into the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent's Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it.

attacks.name: Moon's Invite
attacks.effect: Move as many damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent's other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.name: N
cards.effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hydro Reflect
attacks.effect: You may move all Energy cards attached to Palkia to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Brilliant Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Fairy Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.effect: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Scizor ex by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Cross Fusion Strike
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Max Miracle
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Starbirth
abilities.effect: During your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Trinity Nova
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon V in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Intrepid Sword
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Brave Blade
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Steam Blast
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy card attached to Lugia.

attacks.name: Expert Splasher
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
